findings.title: Task 8T omits renderer tests for three outcome kinds the design requires
findings.description: The design's Technical Requirements require `renderAdoptionFacts` tests for "every outcome, the state-set notice, 'none found' facts, the squadron bullet." Task 8T enumerates only brownfield (capped), adoption-in-progress, and `NOT_EVALUATED`. The `adoption-closed`, `already-planned`, and `greenfield` outcome bullets are never asserted. This matters beyond completeness: the renderer only runs when the brownfield prompt is selected, so in production those three kinds are reachable only via the `in_progress`/`declined` state bullets path — effectively never — meaning the untested branches would be exercised by no other task (Task 12 fixtures for greenfield/planned/closed assert the *absence* of the facts section, not their rendering). Add three cases to Task 8T asserting the outcome bullet text for `adoption-closed`, `already-planned`, and `greenfield`.

findings.title: Design scope line mentions `hasBuildManifest` reuse that no fact consumes
findings.description: The design's Technical Scope says "The report reuses 260's `recognizeCi` and `hasBuildManifest` unchanged," but D5's authoritative fact list (source, history, docs, adrs, ruleFiles, ci) contains no build-manifest fact, and no task uses `hasBuildManifest`. The tasks correctly follow D5, so no requirement is left unmet and no task change is needed — but the scope sentence is loose and worth cleaning up if the design is revised, so a later reader doesn't conclude the tasks dropped a fact.
